description: Ministry of Finance - Annual Report issued under section 13 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act No. 3 of 2003
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the availability of an annual report from the Ministry of Finance, specifically related to public financial management and fiscal responsibility. It deals with the administrative function of making government reports available for public inspection and purchase, which falls under public sector services and administration rather than government structural changes, personnel appointments, or any of the specialized categories like legal, commercial, or land matters.
